app/config.py.role: Dataclass configuration singletons (Config.lidar, Config.slam, Config.mavlink_attitude, ...). Env-var driven, read once at import time.
app/config.py.note: Mutating a Config.* singleton attribute in a test leaks into every later test that doesn't pass its own config instance -- see CORRESPONDENCE_LOG.md Entry 13 for the exact bug this caused in SLAMEngine().

app/security.py.role: Auth (token hash/validate), rate limiting, path-traversal guards (safe_join, validate_path_component).
app/security.py.note: Any change here touches every state-changing REST route via @require_auth/@require_rate_limit decorators in main.py.

app/lidar_driver.py.role: TFmini-S UART driver: 9-byte frame parsing, checksum, sentinel/saturation decoding, auto-reconnect, monotonic timestamps.
app/lidar_driver.py.note: Hardware-adjacent. No app/config import -- constructor takes explicit params from main.py's Config reads.

app/mavlink_imu.py.role: D1: MAVLink 3D attitude (quaternion/Euler math, MAVLinkAttitudeReader). pymavlink optional at import time.
depended_on_by: app/ekf_3d_attitude.py (indirect: quaternion_to_rotation_matrix reused for SE3 pose)
app/mavlink_imu.py.note: Deferred-decision module (P9 field validation pending hardware). Feature-flagged via Config.mavlink_attitude.enabled, default off.

app/multipath_detector.py.role: D2: 2-component Gaussian mixture (hand-rolled EM) for scattered-light/turbidity outlier rejection.
app/multipath_detector.py.note: P9-sim validated (100% detection / 0% FP @ 3 NTU synthetic). Percentile init + Ashman's-D bimodality guard fixed a real 16.5% false-positive bug -- see docs/P9_SIMULATION_VALIDATION.md.

app/environmental_correction.py.role: D3+D4: depth-dependent refractive index n(z) + temperature ToF drift compensation.
app/environmental_correction.py.note: Feature-flagged, default off. main.py's set_depth()/_fresh_depth() gate this on depth-sample staleness.

app/ekf_3d_attitude.py.role: D8: 9-DOF (position+attitude+velocity) EKF fusing LiDAR/SLAM position with MAVLink attitude. Joseph-form covariance update.
app/ekf_3d_attitude.py.note: P9-sim: 49.5% position RMSE improvement vs raw. Field P9 (real trajectories) still pending.

app/slam_engine.py.role: ICP-based scan-to-scan registration (Open3D), accumulated point cloud, drift/degeneracy handling.
app/slam_engine.py.note: SLAMEngine() defaults to the SHARED Config.slam singleton when no config passed -- always construct with an explicit SLAMConfig() in tests that mutate config fields.

app/localization.py.role: Scan-to-map ICP localization (LocalizationEngine) + standalone particle filter (ParticleFilterLocalizer).

app/map_manager.py.role: Atomic map persistence: staging-dir + fsync + os.replace swap, multi-format (ply/pcd/npy/h5), metadata validation.
app/map_manager.py.note: Blind Spot Audit R2 domain 17 hardening: power-loss-safe by design now. Do not reintroduce a non-atomic write path.

app/profile_recorder.py.role: Navigation waypoint recording/playback (ProfileRecorder), route guidance state machine (ProfileNavigator).

app/object_detection.py.role: Pattern analysis (edge/flat/oscillating) + KD-tree DBSCAN-style clustering for obstacle classification.

app/scanner_3d.py.role: 3D object scanner: orbit-scan point accumulation, per-layer coverage tracking.

app/data_quality.py.role: IQR/Z-score/rate-of-change outlier filtering with regime-change recovery (Rule 4).

app/main.py.role: Flask REST API + Flask-SocketIO server. Orchestrates every other module; owns the singleton LiDARSLAMApplication + lidar_app instance.
app/main.py.note: Highest blast radius in the repo -- every module funnels through here. 729 statements, 98% covered. Changing a route's decorator order changes auth/rate-limit interaction (see Blind Spot Audit R2 domain 18 #4).

app/web/static/js/app.js.role: Main dashboard event wiring, status polling, per-mode UI updates.

app/web/static/js/api.js.role: Thin fetch wrapper: token header injection, error normalization to {success:false,...}.

app/web/templates/index.html.role: Single-page dashboard shell; loads CDN three.js/socket.io (Blind Spot Audit R2 20-1: no offline fallback yet).
